component.name: Sensorium Host
component.summary: Share this machine over your own tailnet

description.p: Run Sensorium Host in a KDE Plasma Wayland session on the machine you want to reach. Allow screen sharing and show a six-digit pairing code to connect from the Sensorium viewer on your other machine.
You can turn off screen sharing for any paired machine. A visible indicator names the connected machine and lets you end the session. The two machines talk directly over their own Tailscale tailnet.
